name: Tsuki no Furu Yoru
source:
2028 AD. It's hardly a world imagined in science fiction, people live the same life as before. Main character moves to live alone for his father's sake. This city makes him feel small. He expects a normal boring student life, but he meets three girls there that change his life...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-august-2004-sorauta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
公元2028年。这根本不是科幻小说中想象的世界，人们过着和以前一样的生活。主角为了父亲的缘故搬去独自生活。这座城市让他感觉自己很渺小。他原本期待着平凡无聊的学生生活，但他在那里遇到了三个改变他生活的女孩……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-august-2004-sorauta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
